zh.title: 捷藍航空A321neo在洛杉磯重飛時機尾觸地，第二次進場落地
zh.summary: 捷藍航空 B61187 航班在洛杉磯國際機場重飛時，機尾碰觸跑道，約 16 分鐘後降落。
body: 據《The Aviation Herald》引述美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的初步通報，捷藍航空一架 Airbus A321neo 客機於洛杉磯當地時間 11 月 22 日深夜，在洛杉磯國際機場重飛時發生機尾觸地。這架註冊編號 N2193J 的客機執飛自波士頓出發的 B61187 航班；報導指出，飛機約在晚間 11 時 44 分於 25L 跑道進場時重飛，機尾在過程中碰觸跑道。
客機隨後重新進場，在同一條跑道降落。Flightradar24 的紀錄顯示，航班在當地時間 11 月 23 日凌晨 0 時 1 分落地。《Simple Flying》11 月 24 日報導，這架客機當時仍停在洛杉磯。FAA 初步通報的引文未說明觸地原因。

en.title: JetBlue Airbus A321neo strikes tail during Los Angeles go-around, then lands on second approach
en.summary: JetBlue flight B61187 struck its tail on the runway during a go-around at Los Angeles International Airport before landing about 16 minutes later.
body: A JetBlue Airbus A321neo struck its tail during a go-around at Los Angeles International Airport late on November 22 local time, according to a preliminary U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) entry quoted by The Aviation Herald. The aircraft, registered N2193J, was operating flight B61187 from Boston. The Aviation Herald reported that the crew began the go-around on approach to runway 25L at about 11:44 p.m. and that the tail contacted the runway.

The aircraft made another approach and landed on the same runway. Flightradar24 records the touchdown at 12:01 a.m. local time on November 23. Simple Flying reported on November 24 that the aircraft remained in Los Angeles at the time of its report. The quoted FAA entry did not identify a cause.

facts.claim: An FAA preliminary entry quoted by The Aviation Herald reported a tail strike during a go-around. The publication placed the runway 25L event at about 11:44 p.m. local time on November 22 and reported another landing approach to the same runway.
The N2193J flight history identifies flight B61187 from Boston to Los Angeles and records touchdown at 12:01 a.m. local time after the November 22 departure.
Simple Flying reported on November 24 that the aircraft remained on the ground in Los Angeles at the time of its report.
